title: Architecture-Context Consumer Benchmark Corpus
description: Schema for benchmark questions that evaluate the quality and completeness of architecture-context documentation for consumer agents.

architecture_context_version.description: Git commit SHA of the architecture-context this corpus was validated against.

generated.description: ISO 8601 date when this corpus was generated.

composite_formula.description: Formula for computing the composite quality score.

id.description: Unique question identifier. Format: TIER_PREFIX-NNN (INV-001, FACT-001, INTG-001, NAV-001).

consumer.description: The consumer agent persona that would ask this question.

question.description: The natural-language question to pose to the agent under test.

expected_answer.description: The ground-truth answer, extracted from or validated against on-disk sources.

acceptable_variants.description: Alternative phrasings or partial answers that should also score well.

source_file.description: Path to the on-disk file containing the evidence, relative to the repository root.

source_line.description: Line number or line range (e.g. '79-89') where the evidence appears.

not_documented_expected.description: True if the correct answer is 'not documented' or 'not found'. Tests gap acknowledgment.

required_scope.description: What content the agent needs access to in order to answer this question. architecture = architecture/ tree only; architecture+overlays = also needs overlays/; full-repo = needs docs/, plans, or repo structure outside architecture/.
